# Passport data model

<!-- Generated by generate_er.py from docker/deployment/init-db.sql. Do not edit by hand. -->

42 tables, generated from the DDL in [`docker/deployment/init-db.sql`](../../docker/deployment/init-db.sql), which is the source of truth. After a schema change, regenerate with `python docs/data-model/generate_er.py`.

- Keys are marked `PK`, `FK` and `UK` (unique). Every identifier is a `varchar` UUID.
- `created_by` and `last_updated_by` reference `personnel` from most tables. They are listed as attributes but not drawn, so the real structure stays visible.
- Each relationship is drawn once, in the domain of the table holding the foreign key. Tables from other domains appear there without attributes.

For how the data model fits the wider system, see the [component overview](../architecture/README.md).

## Study and organization

Who takes part: organizations, their personnel and software agents, the study and its members.

```mermaid
erDiagram
    organization {
        varchar organization_id PK
        varchar name
        varchar address
        varchar organization_admin_id
    }
    personnel {
        varchar person_id PK
        varchar organization_id FK
        varchar first_name
        varchar last_name
        varchar email
    }
    software_agent {
        varchar software_agent_id PK
        varchar name
        varchar version
        text description
        varchar keycloak_client_id UK
    }
    study {
        varchar study_id PK
        varchar name
        text description
        text objectives
        text ethics
        varchar owner FK
    }
    study_personnel {
        varchar study_id PK, FK
        varchar personnel_id PK, FK
        varchar role
    }
    study_organization {
        varchar study_id PK, FK
        varchar organization_id PK, FK
        varchar role
        varchar responsible_personnel_id FK
        varchar population_id FK
    }
    experiment {
        varchar experiment_id PK
        varchar study_id FK
        text research_question
    }
    survey {
        varchar survey_id PK
        varchar study_id FK
        text question
        text answer
        varchar category
    }
    organization |o--o{ personnel : "organization_id"
    personnel |o--o{ study : "owner"
    study |o--o{ experiment : "study_id"
    study |o--o{ survey : "study_id"
    study ||--o{ study_personnel : "study_id"
    personnel ||--o{ study_personnel : "personnel_id"
    study ||--o{ study_organization : "study_id"
    organization ||--o{ study_organization : "organization_id"
    personnel |o--o{ study_organization : "responsible_personnel_id"
    population |o--o{ study_organization : "population_id"
```

## Cohort and features

The declarative definitions executed by Studyfyr, each identified by (url, version).

```mermaid
erDiagram
    population {
        varchar population_id PK
        varchar study_id FK
        varchar population_url
        varchar version
        text description
        text characteristics
    }
    featureset {
        varchar featureset_id PK
        varchar experiment_id FK
        varchar title
        varchar featureset_url
        varchar version
        text description
        timestamp created_at
        varchar created_by FK
        timestamp last_updated_at
        varchar last_updated_by FK
    }
    feature {
        varchar feature_id PK
        varchar featureset_id FK
        varchar title
        text description
        varchar data_type
        boolean isOutcome
        boolean mandatory
        boolean isUnique
        varchar units
        varchar equipment
        varchar data_collection
        varchar concept_uri
        varchar concept_system
        varchar concept_code
        text extraction_definition
        varchar extraction_definition_url
        timestamp created_at
        varchar created_by FK
        timestamp last_updated_at
        varchar last_updated_by FK
    }
    study |o--o{ population : "study_id"
    experiment |o--o{ featureset : "experiment_id"
    featureset |o--o{ feature : "featureset_id"
```

## Data quality

Quality criteria definitions and the assessments run against datasets.

```mermaid
erDiagram
    quality_criteria {
        varchar quality_criteria_id PK

        varchar title

    quality_criterion {
        varchar quality_criterion_id PK

        timestamp executed_at

    quality_criterion_assessment_result {
        varchar result_id PK

    experiment |o--o{ quality_criteria : "experiment_id"

    feature |o--o{ quality_criterion : "feature_id"
    dataset |o--o{ quality_assessment : "dataset_id"
    quality_criteria |o--o{ quality_assessment : "quality_criteria_id"
    quality_assessment |o--o{ quality_criterion_assessment_result : "quality_assessment_id"
    quality_criterion |o--o{ quality_criterion_assessment_result : "quality_criterion_id"
```

## Passport and audit

The signed, versioned passport and the audit log it freezes.

```mermaid
erDiagram
    passport {
        varchar passport_id PK
        varchar model_id FK
        varchar study_id FK
        integer version
        varchar previous_passport_id FK
        timestamp created_at
        varchar created_by FK
        timestamp approved_at
        varchar approved_by FK
        jsonb details_json
        bytea signed_pdf
        varchar signed_pdf_hash
    }
    audit_log {
        varchar audit_log_id PK
        varchar actor_id
        varchar actor_name
        varchar actor_type
        varchar study_id FK
        timestamp occurred_at
        varchar action_type
        varchar affected_relation
        varchar affected_record_id
        text affected_record
        text description
    }
    audit_log_book {
        varchar audit_log_id PK, FK
        varchar passport_id PK, FK
    }
    model |o--o{ passport : "model_id"
    study |o--o{ passport : "study_id"
    passport |o--o{ passport : "previous_passport_id"
    personnel |o--o{ passport : "approved_by"
    study |o--o{ audit_log : "study_id"
    audit_log ||--o{ audit_log_book : "audit_log_id"
    passport ||--o{ audit_log_book : "passport_id"
```
